description: The tester legs that must be green on the exact head of a release candidate before it is cut (ADR-2198). scripts/release/check-candidate-legs.py reads it; scripts/release/tests/test_check_candidate_legs.py pins every job name to the workflow that defines it. A leg that is skipped, missing or red is not green: a master push or a pull request skips a leg whose inputs did not change.
